name: Murgh Musallam
subtitle: a whole chicken stuffed with boiled eggs and simmered in a rich birista and nut gravy

ingredients.qty: 1 whole, about 1.2kg, skinned and slashed to the bone at the thighs and breast

ingredients.note: for birista and the gravy base

ingredients.qty: a good pinch, soaked in 3 tbsp warm milk

prepNotes: Marinate the chicken at least 4 hours ahead, or overnight. The slashes must be deep enough for the marinade to reach the bone.
Fry the birista and grind the nut paste before you start cooking; both are needed in quick succession.
Take the chicken out of the fridge an hour before it goes in the pan so it cooks evenly through.

steps.text: Fry 3 of the sliced onions in 4 tbsp ghee over medium heat until deep brown, 14-16 minutes. Drain on paper and let them go crisp, then grind half to a paste with the cashews, almonds and 4 tbsp water.
steps.tip: Cool the birista completely before grinding or the paste turns gluey.

steps.text: Rub the chicken all over and into the slashes with half the ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp salt and the kashmiri chilli. Whisk the yogurt with the coriander powder and coat the bird. Refrigerate 4 hours.
Push the boiled eggs into the cavity and tie the legs together with kitchen string so the stuffing stays put.
Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a wide heavy pan and brown the marinated chicken on all sides, 8-10 minutes, turning with two spoons. Lift it out and reserve any marinade left in the bowl.
steps.tip: Handle it by the cavity, not the legs, or the skinned meat tears.

steps.text: In the same pan crackle the bay leaves, cinnamon, cloves and both cardamoms for 30 seconds, then add the remaining sliced onion and cook to soft gold, 7 minutes.

Add the rest of the ginger-garlic paste, fry 2 minutes, then stir in the nut-and-birista paste and the reserved marinade. Bhuno on medium heat 8 minutes, until the gravy thickens and ghee rims the pan.
Pour in the hot water with the mace, nutmeg and salt and bring to a simmer. Lower the chicken in breast-side down, spooning gravy over it.
Cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat 45 minutes, turning the bird once at the halfway mark and basting twice.
steps.tip: A knife into the thickest part of the thigh should meet no resistance and run clear.

steps.text: Uncover, spoon over the cream and saffron milk and cook 5 minutes more to glaze. If you want a browned top, slide the open pan under a hot oven grill for 4 minutes.
Finish with the kewra water, rest 10 minutes, then carve at the table with the remaining crushed birista scattered over.

storage: The carved chicken keeps 2 days refrigerated in its gravy. Reheat covered on low with a splash of water; the breast dries out in a microwave, so use a pan.
